GPs here are really dismissive and make you feel like you are wasting their time. I had an allergic reaction which resulted in facial swelling and hives breaking out all over my body - despite not having any known allergies. When I told my GP about this she said that 'we cannot do an allergy test for every person that has an allergic reaction, everyone has these reactions at some point'. On the NHS website it states that an allergy test is appropriate if you have had a reaction with an unknown trigger. I don't feel that I can trust the GPs here with my safety and wellbeing anymore. I book an appointment for medical advice, not to be told 'everyone gets sick sometimes, get over it'.

Just an update on this - I have now had three separate allergic reactions where I have to been rushed to A&E with serious facial swelling and hives. They are clearly serious as I was put in the resuscitation area as soon as I got to A&E. I still do not know the trigger and I have still been denied an allergy test by my GP so I will be changing to a different surgery as this unacceptable and think this GP has resigned from helping people. The doctors and staff are simply going through the motions of NHS guidelines and not really interested in helping people approaching them. When I went to sign up, they didn’t have forms, they even refused saying I must sign up online. When I called during a real problem, they said they’d have to review the information and get back in a week, no reply after a month. Their friendly smiles hides a desire to take no responsibility for their community or make the effort to provide preventative care. I think it’s best for them to shut down or just be honest and say that it’s better to sign up elsewhere.

Update: recently I changed my GP and managed to get a hub appointment here. I’m really surprised that they don’t have appointments for their own patients but enough time to see referred ones. The staff was extremely unhelpful (more interested in chatting with each other about politics than helping patients) and if you’re not from their “specific” community of locals, they’re gonna ignore you completely.
